data_policy: Real Google Search Console data only. Blank cells mean the GSC API returned no data; nothing is estimated.
discovered_keyword_policy: Auto-discovered keywords (queries not in the team's keyword list) are shown only once they accumulate 5+ impressions across recorded weeks, to keep single-impression long-tail noise out of the table. Configured (Primary/Secondary/Related) keywords are always shown regardless of impressions.

ahrefs.note: Ahrefs reports the actual SERP position from a real search check (a whole number), plus search volume and keyword difficulty. Search Console reports average position across impressions, plus impressions, clicks and CTR. Both are real measurements and are shown side by side, never averaged together.
